The modifications in `symbol.c` address a regression introduced by a previous commit that restricted the loading of PE files from the debug cache. The new approach ensures that the symbol resolution is accurate even when the debug files are stripped of non-debug sections or have different file alignments. By utilizing the `__ImageBase` symbol, the patch enhances the robustness of the symbol loading process, thereby fixing the incorrect symbol resolution issue that arose from the earlier changes.
